Questions & Answers

Frequently Asked Questions

Does Let's Buy It replace third-party delivery apps?

Yes! You receive your own dedicated online restaurant menu page on Let's Buy It marketplace where customers can browse, customize items, and order directly with zero commission cuts.

Can multiple waitstaff punch orders at the same time?

Yes, our synchronized cloud architecture allows multiple waiters and cashiers on Android tablets, iPads, or PCs to punch orders simultaneously into the central kitchen queue.

What happens if the kitchen internet disconnects?

The POS continues taking orders and printing thermal receipts locally via browser IndexedDB. Once connectivity is restored, all data automatically reconciles with the database.
